name: stewardmd-app
description: StewardMD — native iOS + Android app wrapper (Capacitor) around the StewardMD PWA. The web app itself is buildless static files at the repo root; scripts/build-www.sh assembles the runtime bundle into www/.

scripts.sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
